items.prompt: Can the undirected component worklist be reused unchanged to label strongly connected components of a directed graph?

options.text: Yes, because every visited set means the same graph property
No; strong connectivity requires different reasoning/algorithm
options.why: The undirected input contract is load-bearing.

options.text: Yes, whenever vertex IDs happen to be sorted
options.why: Identity order does not add reverse reachability.

options.text: No, because directed graphs cannot have cycles
options.why: Directed graphs can have cycles; the property still needs the right algorithm.

items.explanation: An algorithm's graph assumptions determine the property it computes. Do not transfer a label merely because the worklist code looks familiar.
